name: Hollow body hang
cue: Hang with arms straight, ribs down, legs together slightly in front: a hollow shape on the bar.

name: Hollow body hang, 30 s
cue: Same hollow shape, longer. No swinging.

name: Butcher's block stretch
cue: Kneel with elbows on a bench, hold a stick behind your head, sink the chest down. Opens the shoulders for handstands. Needs a bench and a stick.

name: Compact leg lifts
cue: Sit with straight legs, hands beside the knees; lift both heels off the floor without leaning back.

name: Partial reverse Nordic
cue: Kneel tall, lean back in a straight line from knees to head, go only part way, come back up.

name: Reverse Nordic
cue: Full range lean back, hips stay straight, then return.

name: Straddle sit
cue: Sit with legs wide and straight, back tall, walk the chest forward. Flexibility for presses.

name: Shoulder stand
cue: Lie back, lift the hips and legs straight up, support the hips with the hands, body straight.

name: Sissy squat
cue: No support. Knees forward, body in a straight line from knees to head.

name: Gymnastics swing
cue: On the bar, move between hollow and arch with straight arms to build a controlled swing.

name: Roll-back rocks
cue: Roll back onto the shoulders with hands by the ears, then rock forward fast.

name: Kip-up
cue: Roll back, push through the hands and kick the legs out to land on your feet. Use a soft surface.

name: Half dragon squat
cue: Squat on one leg while the other leg passes behind it; hold something for balance. Count each side.

name: Dragon squat
cue: Full depth, free leg behind and off the floor, no support. Count each side.

name: Table-top bridge
cue: Hands behind you, lift the hips until the body is flat like a table.

name: Back bridge
cue: From lying down, push up with hands by the ears into an arch; push the shoulders over the hands.

name: Bulgarian dip
cue: On rings, turn the rings out and let the hands go wide at the bottom. Needs rings.

name: Tuck L-sit to wall handstand
cue: From a tuck L-sit, lean forward and lift the hips until the feet reach the wall.

name: L-sit to handstand
cue: Press from L-sit into a freestanding handstand with straight arms.

name: 90-degree hold, feet on the wall
cue: Bent arms at 90 degrees, body level, feet resting on a wall behind you.

name: 90-degree hold
cue: Same position without the wall.

name: Straddle press from a box
cue: Hands on the floor, feet on a box, lean forward and lift the straddled legs into a handstand.

name: Straddle press
cue: From standing in a straddle, press to handstand with straight arms.

name: Pelican push-up
cue: An advanced deep push-up with the hands far back by the hips. Watch the video chapter for the exact form before trying.

name: Straddle planche push-up
cue: Lower and press while holding the straddle planche.

name: Handstand to kip-up
cue: From a handstand, tuck the chin and roll down, then kip up to your feet in one flow. Use a soft surface.

name: One-leg planche
cue: From advanced tuck, extend one leg straight back; hips stay level.
